runtimeReview.conclusion: Only the product release identity changes to 5.19.0. Save build metadata, schema, keys, storage migration and dependency declarations do not change.

The frozen three-option allow-list accepts only regen, barrier and reduction. Absent/invalid input normalizes to no extra condition. Existing slot, rarity (including zero), trimmed literal case-insensitive name and sort logic remain. itemStats is evaluated only for surviving cheap matches and only when an effect filter is active. It uses each item’s actual positive effect, including preserved legacy semantics. filter/toSorted preserve original item objects and owned-array order.

New count/criteria text describes the exact filtered set, uses escaped text and feeds the existing single live region. Pagination follows filtering. Action/comparison state and whole-bag salvage authority remain separate from displayed matches. User copy distinguishes passive surviving-roll healing from conditional/kill healing, opening ward from conditional resonance ward, and base reduction from low-health reduction; current-build caps are deferred to comparison. Default relic help retains empty-slot and explicit replacement guidance.

Only transient UI fields and explicit result announcements are added. Successful new/import replacement clears slot, rarity, defense, committed name, draft and page after saving succeeds. Sort remains a preference. Explicit same-run branch imports also reset. Ordinary same-run external updates and identical mirror notifications retain choices. Different-run synchronization resets exclusions. Cancelled replacement and primary-write failure do not reach reset. Dedicated preparation clears stale exclusions; ordinary navigation preserves them.

Slot, rarity, defense, sort, clear-name, clear-all and name-submit actions announce the newly rendered result once. Draft input only updates the draft; comparison/navigation/unrelated renders do not call this announcer. textContent avoids HTML insertion into the polite atomic #announcement region. No save call or engine action was introduced into filtering.

Native labeled select and focus outline are preserved. Filter/control layout uses scoped three-column and narrow two-column rules with the defense select spanning its own row below 480px. Help text can wrap and stays at least 12px in the recorded logical viewports.

Desktop-only non-fusion sidebar rows now use minmax(min-content,1fr), with existing rail vertical scrolling and unrestricted title wrapping. This addresses actual content spill while retaining complete fields; it does not hide or truncate names. Mobile and fusion layout contracts are outside this added selector scope.

previousFocusedAppChecks.source: Previously executed integration receipts retained under docs/iteration/evidence/round19/independent; not rerun during this review.

compatibilityAndTransactions.newPredicateTestsReviewed: 11 source-level test cases cover authored/legacy effects, exclusion of differently triggered effects, invalid inputs, stable sorts, cheap short-circuiting, complete-state preservation, full-bag safety scope, 10,000-item late matches and the retained natural fixture.

sidebarEvidence.rootCause: Fixed equal-height rows combined with non-shrinking long-name content let armor effects extend 33.171875px and depth metadata 50.640625px below their owning card.
sidebarEvidence.geometryQualification: Two-pixel tolerance accounts for browser text/border rounding; both row boxes and DOM Range bounds of actual rendered text are measured, not merely parent scroll width.

newBrowserQADriverReview.scope: Disposable loopback origin and fresh contexts only; archived fixture and layout renames labeled explicitly. Native controls are used for game actions; injected state is only isolated fixture setup, write instrumentation and an explicit primary-write failure.
newBrowserQADriverReview.completeStateAssertions: exactState deep-compares both decoded main and mirror to complete expected state and requires identical encoded records. noWrite compares both original encoded records, complete decoded state and count of save/mirror setItem attempts. Engine actions are compared to exact transitions; no internal game UI state is assigned.
newBrowserQADriverReview.geometryAssertions: Records per-control bounds and overlap; checks 12px new text and 44px narrow inputs; measures all four content rows and rendered text inside each of five desktop equipped cards, internal clipping, adjacent overlap, horizontal rail spill, vertical scrollability, reachable last card and no storage writes during scrolling. Comparison dialog bounds/long identities and return-to-context checks remain.
newBrowserQADriverReview.sourceIdentityAndRunner: Before/after source hashes include responsive.css; overall PASS requires every expected group, no runtime errors and stable source. Geometry is retained before assertions, preserving failures.
newBrowserQADriverReview.limitations: Oracle uses unchanged itemStats/itemValue to derive expected filtered IDs/order; this establishes displayed behavior, not independent combat-balance validity. Synthetic renamed states and archived manual replay are not presented as newly observed natural journeys.

visualInspection.method: Viewed existing JPEG at original resolution
visualInspection.observation: Desktop filter labels and counts are visible; long CJK equipped armor title wraps above its own effects and provenance inside its border. Excess sidebar content uses the existing vertical rail; browser checks establish last-card reachability.

visualInspection.observation: Narrow screen uses separate full-width defense select below quality/sort; search and clear controls remain separate, literal continuous ASCII criteria wrap, and the bottom navigation remains available. The screenshot shows a scroll position, not the entire page.

Protection-dialog and no-write assertions strengthened; original complete-state cancel/commit/reload/two-tab/stale-import assertions remain. Unique page suffixes preserve all failure screenshots.
